name: Spring river flooding – Red River Valley
description: The flat Red River Valley floods in spring. The 1997 flood came close to the capacity of the Red River Floodway and forced evacuations in the valley; Canada and Manitoba then invested $628 million to expand the floodway from a 1-in-160-year to a 1-in-700-year event capacity for Winnipeg.

exposed_areas: Communities in the Red River Valley outside the Winnipeg floodway
Winnipeg (protected by the floodway to the stated design level)
documented_events: 1997: flood near floodway capacity; valley communities evacuated (Government of Manitoba)
practical_implications: Rural properties in the valley rely on ring dikes

sources.title: Canada's Changing Climate Report (2019) – Headline statements
sources.publisher: Government of Canada (Environment and Climate Change Canada, lead)
sources.methodology: Assessment report; statements are assessments of observed and projected change, not local forecasts

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: Design levels are engineering targets, not guarantees. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
